chapters.name: The man in the grey suit

youtube.title: What If You Went Back to 2010 With $100?
tags: what if you went back in time
youtube.intro: You wake up in May 2010 with every memory of the next sixteen years and one crumpled $100 bill. You buy ten thousand bitcoins, the same pile someone just spent on two pizzas. Then come the hacks, the crashes, a man in a grey suit who knows far too much, and a choice that could cost your family their home.
